title: Household Add-On Membership: linkage to the primary membership's own status, and dues-waiver and seasonal-discount basis
content:
## Scope
This document states, for each Household Add-On Membership tier, whether the add-on automatically suspends when the primary membership freezes, whether it automatically closes when the primary membership closes, whether dues may be waived during a documented medical hold, and the discount rate applied during a promotional period.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Auto-suspend on primary suspension | Auto-close on primary closure | Medical-hold dues waiver allowed | Seasonal promotional discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spouse Add-On | yes | yes | allowed | 5 percent |
| Domestic Partner Add-On | yes | yes | allowed | 5 percent |
| Dependent Child Add-On | yes | yes | allowed | 5 percent |
| Young Adult Add-On | yes | yes | allowed | 5 percent |
| Senior Parent Add-On | yes | yes | allowed | 5 percent |
| Household Multi-Add-On | yes | yes | allowed | 5 percent |

## Points of judgement
- Every tier of the Household Add-On Membership shares the same basis on all four points: the add-on automatically suspends whenever the primary membership is frozen, automatically closes whenever the primary membership closes, allows dues to be waived during a documented medical hold, and carries a 5 percent discount rate during a promotional period.
- Because the automatic-suspend and automatic-close bases are set to yes for every tier today, a household add-on's active status is never independent of its primary membership's own status; a frozen primary membership carries every one of that primary member's add-ons into suspension with it, and a closed primary membership carries every one of them into closure with it.
